failure_summary.description: Agents chose a related building, repeated clue text instead of completing it, or substituted a modern or adjacent entity despite existing slot and evidence-check guidance.
Agents added an associated person or unnecessary name parts, or used a related but grammatically mismatched word form instead of the expected concise answer.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already covers answer-slot identification, clue completion, evidence checks, concise granularity, and context-supported answer forms. These failures reflect noncompliance with those rules rather than a generalizable gap, so additional edits would duplicate existing guidance.
